description: Cross-language AEAD vectors for SymmetricEncryptor -- and a documented INCOMPATIBILITY, found by this vector suite. Each ciphertext was generated by encrypting the same plaintext under the same key in that language. Unlike PasswordHasher and CsrfTokenManager, these ciphertexts are NOT universally cross-language compatible, because the languages use different underlying AEAD constructions (see root README's 'Vetted Cryptography per Language' table). Empirically verified compatibility groups: Go and PHP both use XChaCha20-Poly1305 (24-byte nonce) and can decrypt each other's ciphertext. JavaScript and Java both use AES-256-GCM (12-byte nonce + 16-byte tag) and can decrypt each other's ciphertext. Python uses plain ChaCha20-Poly1305 (12-byte nonce) and is NOT compatible with any other port -- not even JS/Java, despite producing a same-length blob, because the underlying cipher differs. See THREAT_MODEL.md for the full implication and a recommended fix if full 5-way interop is required.
